findings.reason: the plan's closure condition is a claim its own content contradicts once §9 is added, so the author either widens it to §3–§9 or states why §9 does not gate closure.
findings.text: §7's stated plan closure ("The plan closes when the last of §3–§7 lands and the guard's allowlist is empty") predates §9, which was added the same day and lies outside §3–§7, so the plan's own completion measure omits a declared deliverable and a coordinator following it literally could close the plan with §9 unbuilt, leaving the §4 reload regression §9 exists to guard unaddressed
